verdict.rationale: Notion's docs show user-scoped Personal Access Tokens for scripts/agents and OAuth-based public integrations with a security review process, which provide some credential scoping, but the pack lacks detail on fine-grained capability/page-level permission controls or explicit 'least privilege' agent scoping guidance. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-capability (read/insert/update/comment) scoping UI, page-level access restriction workflow, and independent verification that scoped tokens actually limit agent access in practice.
